name: Jailer Melitus
reaction:
Hostile
Friendly (initially, when speaking to Adonatus)

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Hemorrhage
abilities.description: A minor physical damage over time applied by Slash.

abilities.name: Bloody Cleave
abilities.description: The boss swings its sword in an arc dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Bloodmoon's Mercy
abilities.description: The boss summons a burst of magic around itself dealing moderate magical damage as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Moonlit Rage
abilities.description: Five smaller AOEs will be released outwards from the boss once Bloodmoon's Mercy triggers. These deal moderate magical damage and snare any target hit.

abilities.name: Bloody Geyser
abilities.description: The boss spawns blood geysers under each person in the group dealing moderate magical damage as indicated by red circles. Keep moving to avoid this.

abilities.name: Bloody Execution
abilities.description: The boss stuns one target and swings his sword at them after a short delay. This deals lethal damage on veteran mode. Interrupt the boss to prevent this.

abilities.name: Summon Minions
abilities.description: Werewolf Bloodcallers and archers will spawn to attack the group. Kill them quickly to simplify the fight.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Oh, come now. Where's that Silver Dawn valor gone off to?
dialogue.trigger: As you enter the dungeon, you'll hear him taunting Adonatus Varian

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Make sure this one doesn't go running off, you hear? I'm not done with him yet.
dialogue.trigger: As you enter the dungeon, you'll hear him taunting Adonatus Varian

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Vykosa never does mind if I eat a prisoner or two.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: How do you taste, I wonder? I bet you're all delicious.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Oh good. I was just starting to feel peckish!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Trying to escape? You'll have to get through me first.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Got out of your cell, huh? Well, don't expect me to just put you back!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: I'm sure Vykosa wouldn't mind if I killed just a few of you, eh?

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: No one leaves his prison. At least, no one leaves alive.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: I'll show you why I'm the one who runs this prison!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Count yourselves lucky! Your deaths will be quick.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: It is time to face your execution!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Your heads shall make fine trophies!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: I'll offer Vykosa your heads!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Guards! Empty the cells!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Let's give our prisoners a feast!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Open the cell doors! It's time to feed the prisoners.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Release the prisoners! I'm sure they're hungry.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: In this prison, I'm both judge and executioner!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Looks like I'll have a lovely meal tonight!

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: You all should have stayed in your cells.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: Don't worry. I'll make sure your corpses don't go to waste.

dialogue.speaker: Jailer Melitus
dialogue.line: I'm sure my guards will appreciate some fresh meat!
